# Factu

Factu is a free browser tool that checks whether your invoicing is ready for VeriFactu (the Spanish invoicing-system regulation, RD 1007/2023). It runs entirely in the browser (no data leaves the device).

## Key facts (verified 14 August 2026)

- VeriFactu is regulated by Real Decreto 1007/2023 (BOE-A-2023-24840); deadlines were extended by Real Decreto-ley 15/2025 (2 December 2025).
- Entities that file Impuesto de Sociedades (corporate income tax) must have their invoicing system (SIF) adapted before 1 January 2027.
- All other taxpayers (autónomos and SMEs) must adapt before 1 July 2027.
- Required features: unalterable billing record, chained hash (digital signature), verifiable QR code and traceability.
- From your deadline you cannot issue invoices with non-adapted software; the Tax Agency (AEAT) foresees fines of up to 50,000 EUR (Ley Antifraude).
- VeriFactu (SIF) is not the same as mandatory B2B e-invoicing (Ley 18/2022, Crea y Crece), which still awaits its implementing regulation.
- Context: ATA reports that autónomos spend 226 hours a year on administrative procedures, costing 3,390 EUR per autónomo (10/08/2026).

5. https://ata.es/noticias/crecen-las-trabas-los-autonomos-226-horas/ (ATA — 226 hours / 3,390 EUR)

## Pricing

- Free: VeriFactu gap check + deadline (IS or autónomo) + fine exposure + interactive checklist.
- Pro (12 USD one-time, crypto via NOWPayments): printable Recibo Stamp PDF, step-by-step SIF adaptation plan, supplier conformity template, permanent unlock.

## Not advice

Factu is an educational tool based on Real Decreto 1007/2023 and Real Decreto-ley 15/2025. It is not tax or legal advice. Editorial responsibility: attenciona (Holding), Spain.
